## Personality

Charlie Sloane harbors a long-standing ambition to enter politics. His ultimate goal is to become a member of Parliament.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## History

Charlie Sloane joined an advanced class formed by Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) to prepare students for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. He had previously engaged in literary pursuits prior to this time.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--charlie-sloane.md)

Charlie and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) maintain an adversarial relationship defined by mutual distaste and resentment. Their ongoing enmity has persisted over time alongside Anne's broader interpersonal conflicts and academic rivalries.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023)_

- Enemy of — mutual distaste and resentment  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023)</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlie-sloane--gilbert-blythe.md)

Charlie and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are rivals who compete directly for the affection of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Their romantic rivalry forms the central dynamic between them as they both vie for her favor.

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P0](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0000)_
